findings: 🟠 [preflight-ledger-source] MUST-FIX The preflight always reads `campaignLedgerPathFor(identity)` and ignores the supported explicit `--campaign-ledger`/intake ledger path; a durable-wait resume sourced from an explicit ledger can therefore skip pre-claim verification when its campaign is absent from the default ledger, consume a Mission claim, and only fail during generation binding. Resolve the ledger through the same path-selection logic used by the generation claim and add a drift-spy case using an explicit ledger.
